name: @veren/device-id-linux
description: Use on Linux only as the platform plugin for @veren/device-id: it collects the stable-tier hardware fingerprint from DMI (/sys/class/dmi/id product_uuid, product_serial, board_serial; root may be required) and keeps a best-effort anchor file in ~/.local/state/veren; /etc/machine-id is excluded from the fingerprint because an OS reinstall regenerates it; skip it on non-Linux hosts.
